title: Optimist Deep Research: An Iterative, State-Centric Agent for Autonomous Literature Research
title_zh: Optimist Deep Research：一个用于自主文献研究的迭代式、以状态为中心的智能体

paragraphs.en: Most retrieval-augmented systems treat literature search as a single retrieval step followed by summarization. Real literature research works differently: the investigator’s understanding of the question changes as they read, new subquestions appear, and evidence is weighed, not just collected. We present Optimist Deep Research, an open-source agent that runs literature research as an iterative evidence-acquisition process over an explicit, mutable research state. A research question is broken into a tree of subquestions, each served by search intents that are translated into source-specific queries over arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, PubMed, Semantic Scholar and the web. Results are merged into a canonical, provenance-preserving document registry through a conservative four-tier deduplication hierarchy. The registry is expanded by citation snowballing until a saturation criterion is met, and then screened, ranked and allocated to subquestions round-robin. Documents are read in parallel into a structured evidence store of claims with support, location, type and strength. A critic reviews the state along eight dimensions and returns research actions rather than a binary verdict: it can add, split, rephrase, deprioritize or close subquestions, so the research plan is an output of the investigation as well as an input. The final report is written section by section from the evidence store, and every citation resolves to a retrieved document. We describe the design, the deterministic machinery that keeps a language-model pipeline auditable, and a case study that read 28 of 237 retrieved documents in about three and a half minutes. We also report weaknesses the case study exposed.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数检索增强系统将文献检索视为单步检索加摘要生成。 真正的文献研究并非如此：研究者对问题的理解会随着阅读不断变化，新的子问题不断出现，证据需要权衡，而不仅仅是收集。 我们提出了 Optimist Deep Research，一个开源智能体（agent），它将文献研究作为在一个显式、可变的研究状态之上运行的迭代式证据获取过程。 研究问题被分解为一棵子问题树，每个子问题由若干搜索意图服务，这些搜索意图被转换为针对 arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref、PubMed、Semantic Scholar 和网络的特定来源查询。 检索结果通过保守的四层去重层级，合并到一个保留出处的规范化文档注册库中。 该注册库通过引文滚雪球不断扩展，直到满足饱和标准，随后经过筛选、排序，并以轮转方式分配给各子问题。 文档被并行阅读，形成包含论断及其支持信息、位置、类型和强度的结构化证据库。 一个评审者从八个维度审查研究状态，并返回研究行动而非二元判定：它可以新增、拆分、改写、降低优先级或关闭子问题，因此研究计划既是研究过程的输入，也是其输出。 最终报告基于证据库逐节撰写，且每条引用都可解析到一篇已检索的文档。 我们描述了系统设计、使语言模型流水线保持可审计的确定性机制，以及一个在大约三分半钟内阅读 237 篇检索文档中 28 篇的案例研究。 我们还报告了案例研究所暴露的缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) combined with retrieval have become a standard way to answer knowledge-intensive questions [ 22 ] . For literature research , meaning the task of establishing what a body of scholarly work says about a question, a single round of retrieve-then-summarize falls short in three ways.

paragraphs.en: First, the right decomposition of a research question is rarely clear at the start. It becomes clear while reading: a paper introduces terminology the investigator did not know, shows that a subquestion has two parts that need separate evidence, or shows that another subquestion is a dead end. Second, the output of reading should be evidence , not summaries. A summary turns a paper into a single opinion. Evidence keeps each claim separate from what supports it, so a later stage can ask whether a claim is established by several independent studies or asserted by one. Third, systematic reviewers have long known that keyword search alone misses relevant work, and that following citations backward and forward is needed for coverage [ 49 , 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 首先，一个研究问题的正确拆解在起始阶段往往并不清晰。 它会在阅读过程中变得清晰：某篇论文引入了研究者原先不知道的术语，表明某个子问题包含需要分别取证的两个部分，或者表明另一个子问题是死胡同。 其次，阅读的产出应当是证据，而不是摘要。 摘会把一篇论文变成单一的观点。 证据把每个论断与支持它的内容分开存放，这样后续阶段就能追问某个论断是由多项独立研究证实的，还是仅由一项研究断言的。 第三，系统性综述的研究者早已知道，仅靠关键词检索会遗漏相关工作，还需要向后和向前追踪引用才能保证覆盖面 [ 49 , 18 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Commercial “deep research” products [ 29 ] popularized agents that browse for many minutes and return long, cited reports. STORM [ 38 ] outlines Wikipedia-style articles through perspective-guided question asking, and Co-STORM [ 15 ] adds a human to the conversation. A growing set of benchmarks measures these agents: BrowseComp for hard-to-find facts [ 48 ] , DeepResearch Bench [ 6 ] , ResearchRubrics [ 39 ] and DEER [ 11 ] for report quality against expert criteria, Total Recall QA for verifiable recall [ 34 ] , and IDRBench for the value of clarifying interaction [ 9 ] . Two findings bear directly on our design. First, SAGE [ 13 ] finds that current agents struggle with reasoning-intensive scientific retrieval, and that BM25 outperforms LLM-based retrievers inside an agent because the agents issue keyword-oriented sub-queries. ODR accepts that sources differ and routes each search intent into source-specific queries rather than one query string for all of them. Second, these benchmarks evaluate an end-to-end answer. ODR’s state records why each document was found and read, which makes stage-level evaluation possible ( Section 14 ).

paragraphs.en: PaperQA [ 20 ] answers scientific questions by retrieving and reading full-text papers. OpenScholar [ 3 ] and Ai2 Scholar QA [ 42 ] build open retrieval pipelines over scholarly corpora for citation-backed synthesis. For paper search specifically, PaSa [ 12 ] trains an agent with reinforcement learning to invoke search tools, read papers and expand through their references, and SPAR [ 40 ] uses multiple agents with reference-chain query decomposition and query evolution. LitSearch [ 2 ] provides a retrieval benchmark for literature search, and LitLLMs [ 1 ] studies literature-review writing as keyword extraction, retrieval, re-ranking and generation. Knowledge Navigator [ 16 ] organizes the results of a broad query into a topic hierarchy that a user refines interactively, and AutoSurvey [ 46 ] drafts full surveys from retrieved papers via outlines and section-wise generation. Further along, Agent Laboratory [ 37 ] and The AI Scientist [ 25 ] place literature review as one stage in an automated research pipeline. Most of these systems either fix the decomposition at the start or adapt only the next query. ODR makes the plan itself revisable: the critic can add, split, rephrase, deprioritize or close subquestions as the evidence comes in. It also keeps an explicit evidence store of claims, rather than passing retrieved text straight to a writer. The closest systems engineering is AgentR [ 36 ] , which persists the intents, queries, paper assessments and gap analyses of an LLM literature-review workflow as durable artifacts for recovery and auditing. ODR shares that view of state, but uses it to drive adaptive planning rather than mainly for fault tolerance.

paragraphs.en: Work on citation-grounded generation [ 10 ] shows that LLMs often cite sources that do not support the claim. The problem persists in deep research agents: across ten models and agents, 3–13% of citation URLs are hallucinated and 5–18% do not resolve, with deep research agents hallucinating at higher rates than search-augmented LLMs [ 35 ] , and cited content is often accessible and relevant but not factually supportive [ 28 ] . These studies detect bad citations after the fact. ODR prevents the first kind structurally. Citations are document identifiers taken from the evidence passed to each report section, unresolvable identifiers are removed, and the reference list is built from the document registry rather than generated by the model. Whether a cited claim is actually supported still depends on the reader’s extraction, which is why the evidence store records support and strength separately from the claim.
paragraphs.zh: 基于引用的生成研究 [ 10 ] 表明，大语言模型经常引用并不支持所述论断的来源。 该问题在深度研究智能体中依然存在：在十个模型和智能体中，3–13% 的引用 URL 是幻觉产生的，5–18% 无法解析，且深度研究智能体的幻觉率高于检索增强的大语言模型 [ 35 ] ，此外被引用的内容往往可以访问且相关，但并不在事实上支持论断 [ 28 ] 。 这些研究是在事后才检测不良引用。 ODR 从结构上杜绝了第一类问题。 引用是从传递给各报告章节的证据中提取的文档标识符，无法解析的标识符会被移除，参考文献列表由文档注册表构建，而非由模型生成。 被引用的论断是否确实得到支持，仍取决于读者的提取，这正是证据库将支持情况与强度同论断分开记录的原因。

paragraphs.en: Kitchenham’s procedures [ 18 , 19 ] and the PRISMA statement [ 30 ] formalize search, screening, eligibility and synthesis for human-conducted reviews. Wohlin [ 49 ] describes backward and forward snowballing as an iterative procedure that runs until no new relevant papers are found, and tool support for forward snowballing remains uneven [ 14 ] . Surveys of AI for systematic reviews [ 5 ] and a scoping review of LLM use [ 24 ] find LLMs applied most often to search, study selection and data extraction, but judge them not yet ready for unsupervised use. Individual studies evaluate LLMs for Boolean query formulation [ 45 ] and title–abstract screening [ 43 ] . InsightAgent [ 33 ] keeps a human in the loop and reports completing a systematic review in hours. SciLitBench [ 51 ] evaluates screening and extraction as linked stages, and ARISMA [ 27 ] proposes reporting guidelines for AI-assisted reviews. ODR implements an automated, budgeted version of the search–screen–snowball cycle. Its saturation criterion directly operationalizes “no new papers,” and its provenance records are the kind of audit trail such guidelines ask for. It does not claim to replace a protocol-driven systematic review.

paragraphs.en: Deduplicating bibliographic records is an instance of record linkage [ 8 , 7 ] . Our hierarchy puts persistent identifiers first and fuzzy matching last, and it is tuned for precision over recall. The reason is specific to this setting: a missed duplicate costs one redundant read, while a false merge silently attributes one paper’s evidence to another.
paragraphs.zh: 去除书目记录的重复是记录链接[8, 7]的一个实例。 我们的层级结构将持久标识符放在首位，将模糊匹配放在末尾，并且它以精确率为先、召回率为后进行调整。 其原因与该场景特定相关：漏掉一条重复记录只会造成一次冗余阅读，而一次错误的合并则会悄然把一篇论文的证据归到另一篇论文上。

paragraphs.en: ODR is implemented as a LangGraph [ 21 ] state graph ( Figure 1 ) built around two loops. The inner loop widens the corpus: it follows the citations of relevant documents already found, screens the new candidates, and stops once further rounds turn up few new documents ( Section 8 ). The outer loop steers the research: after each round of reading, a critic reviews the evidence, edits the research plan, and sends the system back to search for what is still missing ( Section 10 ).
paragraphs.zh: ODR 实现为围绕两个循环构建的 LangGraph [21] 状态图（图 1）。 内层循环扩展语料库：它追踪已找到的相关文献的引用，筛选新的候选文献，并在后续轮次几乎不再发现新文献时停止（第 8 节）。 外层循环引导研究：每轮阅读之后，一个评论者智能体审查证据、修改研究计划，并让系统返回去搜索仍然缺失的内容（第 10 节）。

paragraphs.en: Subquestions and intents are kept as separate levels on purpose. A subquestion states what we need to know , for example “How does episodic memory compare with semantic memory for long-horizon tasks?” A search intent describes a kind of document that would help answer it, for example “empirical comparisons of episodic versus semantic memory on long-horizon benchmarks.” A subquestion can have several intents. This separation lets the system change how it searches (adding, closing or rewording intents and their queries) without changing what it is trying to find out. Each intent also records its yield : how many documents its queries found, and how many of those were screened as relevant. The critic uses these yields to judge whether an intent is still productive.
paragraphs.zh: 子问题和检索意图被刻意保留为两个独立的层级。 子问题陈述我们需要知道什么，例如「情景记忆与语义记忆在长时程任务中相比表现如何？」检索意图描述一类有助于回答该问题的文档，例如「情景记忆与语义记忆在长时程基准上的实证比较」。一个子问题可以有多个检索意图。 这种分离使系统可以改变其检索方式（添加、关闭或改写检索意图及其查询），而不改变它试图弄清楚的内容。 每个检索意图还会记录其产出：它的查询找到了多少文档，其中有多少被筛选为相关。 评审者利用这些产出来判断某个检索意图是否仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: Parallel graph branches write to shared channels, so each channel has a merge function (a reducer ) that must be associative and must tolerate two branches having seen the same baseline. Three rules make this work.
paragraphs.zh: 并行图分支会写入共享通道，因此每个通道都有一个合并函数（reducer，归约器），该函数必须是可结合的，并且必须容忍两个分支看到相同的基线。 三条规则使这一切得以运作。

paragraphs.en: Budgets are written as deltas. Each reader writes documents_read=1 and the reducer sums them, so twenty parallel readers advance the counter by exactly twenty. If branches wrote running totals, each one would need to know what the others had done.
paragraphs.zh: 预算以增量（delta）的形式编写。 每个读取器写入 documents_read=1，归约器（reducer）将它们求和，因此二十个并行读取器会恰好让计数器前进二十。 如果各分支写入的是运行总计，那么每个分支都需要知道其他分支做了什么。

paragraphs.en: Documents merge field by field. The more informative value wins: the longer abstract, the union of sources and provenance, the maximum of each subquestion’s relevance score, and the minimum snowball depth. A sparse web hit therefore never degrades a rich record.
paragraphs.zh: 文档逐字段合并。 信息量更大的值胜出：更长的摘要、来源与出处的并集、每个子问题相关性得分的最大值，以及雪球深度的最小值。 因此，一条稀疏的网络检索结果绝不会降低内容丰富的记录的质量。

paragraphs.en: Each LLM role (planner, intent, query, screener, reader, synthesizer, critic, writer) is routed independently to any provider:model specification. The roles differ in cost by orders of magnitude. Screening and reading run once per document (or batch of documents), while planning and critique run once per iteration . Per-role routing is therefore the main cost control: a capable model on the judgement roles and a cheaper one on the high-volume roles. All structured calls go through one helper that validates output against a Pydantic schema and returns None on failure. Each node then uses an explicit fallback, so a malformed response degrades a single step instead of stopping the run.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 LLM 角色（规划器、意图、查询、筛选器、阅读器、综合器、批评家、写作器）都被独立路由到任意 provider:model 规格。 这些角色之间的成本相差几个数量级。 筛选和阅读每个文档（或文档批次）只运行一次，而规划和批评每次迭代运行一次。 因此，按角色路由是主要的成本控制手段：在判断类角色上使用能力强的模型，在高吞吐量角色上使用更便宜的模型。 所有结构化调用都通过同一个辅助函数，该函数根据 Pydantic 模式校验输出，失败时返回 None。 然后每个节点都使用显式的回退机制，因此格式错误的响应只会使单个步骤降级，而不是终止整个运行。

paragraphs.en: A single query string cannot serve every scholarly API. arXiv uses literal keyword matching with terms combined by AND, Semantic Scholar ranks natural-language queries semantically, and PubMed rewards controlled vocabulary. ODR therefore first selects the sources relevant to an intent and then generates a query specialized for each, up to min ⁡ ( 4 , | sources | ) \min(4,|\text{sources}|) queries per intent. Each (source, query) pair counts as one search operation against the budget. Intents from higher-priority subquestions are planned first, so if the budget runs out, the least important work is the work that is lost. Intents that would produce no new queries are closed.
paragraphs.zh: 单一的查询字符串无法适用于每一个学术 API。arXiv 使用字面关键词匹配并将词项用 AND 组合，Semantic Scholar 对自然语言查询进行语义排序，而 PubMed 则青睐受控词表。 因此，ODR 首先选择与某个意图相关的来源，然后为每个来源生成专门的查询，每个意图最多生成 min(4, |sources|) 个查询。 每个来源与查询的组合对计为一次搜索操作，占用预算。 来自更高优先级子问题的意图会被优先规划，因此如果预算耗尽，被牺牲的是最不重要的工作。 不会产生新查询的意图会被关闭。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 lists the supported sources. arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref and PubMed need no key. Semantic Scholar has three settings ( auto , on , off ), and under auto it is used only when an API key is present. Its unauthenticated pool is shared per IP address and returns HTTP 429 even under light load, so leaving it on without a key spends search budget for nothing. HTTP search runs concurrently inside a single node with a semaphore, rather than as one graph branch per query. Each source already enforces its own rate limit (arXiv asks for one request every three seconds), and per-query branches would bloat the state without any benefit.

paragraphs.en: A single paper often arrives from several sources: arXiv as a preprint, Crossref with the published DOI, OpenAlex with a citation count, and the web as a landing page. These records are merged into one canonical document before reading, which is the expensive stage, and every Provenance record (subquestion, intent, source, query, rank, and whether the document was found by search or by snowballing) is kept. This means a paper retrieved for one subquestion can serve another without being retrieved again, and retrieval coverage can be evaluated afterwards.
paragraphs.zh: 一篇论文往往来自多个来源：arXiv 提供预印本，Crossref 提供已发表的 DOI，OpenAlex 提供引用次数，而网络提供落地页。 这些记录会在阅读（这是成本最高的阶段）之前被合并为一份规范文档，并且每条溯源记录（子问题、意图、来源、查询、排序，以及该文档是通过搜索还是滚雪球方式找到的）都会被保留。 这意味着为某个子问题检索到的论文可以直接服务于另一个子问题而无需再次检索，并且检索覆盖率可以在事后进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Candidates are matched in order of decreasing strength:

paragraphs.en: a persistent identifier: arXiv (version suffix stripped), PubMed, OpenAlex or Semantic Scholar;

paragraphs.zh: 标题相似度至少为 0.93 0.93（SequenceMatcher 比率），并伴有佐证信号（年份或作者）。

paragraphs.en: Tier 4 is the only fuzzy tier, and it is intentionally strict. The threshold of 0.93 0.93 is high because papers in a series (“… Part II”, “ Method v2”) score between 0.85 0.85 and 0.92 0.92 and must not be merged.
paragraphs.zh: Tier 4 是唯一一个模糊层级，并且它被有意设计得非常严格。 0.93 0.93 的阈值之所以很高，是因为同一系列中的论文（「… Part II」、「 Method v2」）的得分介于 0.85 0.85 和 0.92 0.92 之间，绝不能被合并。

paragraphs.en: Numbers in a title almost always distinguish separate works: Llama 2 and Llama 3 , GPT-3 and GPT-4 , Part II and Part III . paragraphs.en: A record may carry a short title or drop a subtitle. A prefix match is accepted only when the shorter title has at least three distinctive tokens, because no length threshold separates a specific stub (“llm planner”) from a generic one (“deep learning”). Containment, meaning all distinctive tokens of the shorter title appear in the longer one, requires at least four.
paragraphs.zh: 记录可以带一个简短标题，或省略副标题。 只有当较短标题至少包含三个有区分度的词元时，前缀匹配才被接受，因为没有长度阈值能区分具体的残缺标题（“llm planner”）与宽泛的标题（“deep learning”）。 包含关系，即较短标题的所有有区分度的词元都出现在较长标题中，则要求至少四个。

paragraphs.en: Names and titles are NFKD-normalized, combining marks are removed, and dash variants are unified before comparison. This fixed a real failure: OpenAlex writes Romera-Paredes with U+2010 HYPHEN, which compared as “paredes” against “romera-paredes” and caused a correct match to be rejected. A full title match is also never vetoed because the author lists do not overlap. Sources render names too inconsistently (initials only, collective authors, transliterations) for that signal to override a matching title. Author agreement is required only when the title evidence is weak.

paragraphs.en: Subquestion synthesis fans out, one branch per subquestion that has evidence. Each branch combines its evidence into an answer, states what the evidence does not establish, and scores its own coverage. Global synthesis then reads those answers and builds the cross-cutting narrative and the report outline. It derives that outline from the findings rather than repeating the initial subquestion list, because the right structure for a literature review usually becomes clear only after the literature has been read.
paragraphs.zh: 子问题综合采用扇出结构，每个有证据的子问题对应一个分支。 每个分支将其证据整合为一个答案，说明证据未能确立的内容，并对自身的覆盖程度进行评分。 全局综合随后读取这些答案，构建贯穿全局的叙述和报告大纲。 该大纲是从研究发现中推导出来的，而不是重复初始的子问题列表，因为文献综述的合适结构通常只有在读完文献之后才会清晰浮现。

paragraphs.en: The critic assesses eight dimensions: coverage, evidence quality, citation coverage, source diversity, contradictions, recency, knowledge gaps, and search saturation. Its inputs include the weakly supported claim clusters, the diversity report, and the yield history of each snowball round and each intent. It does not return a binary verdict. It returns research actions : new search intents, snowball requests, newly detected contradictions, and plan edits ( Table 2 ). Knowledge gaps stated as free text are attached to the subquestion they most likely concern by token overlap. Ties are broken toward subquestions the critic itself flagged as weak, then toward the one with the lowest coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 评审器（critic）评估八个维度：覆盖度、证据质量、引用覆盖率、来源多样性、矛盾点、时效性、知识空白以及搜索饱和度。 其输入包括弱支持论断簇、多样性报告，以及每一轮滚雪球和每个搜索意图的产出历史。 它不返回二元的判定结果。 它返回研究行动：新的搜索意图、滚雪球请求、新检测到的矛盾点以及计划编辑（表 2）。 以自由文本表述的知识空白，通过词元重叠被附加到它们最可能相关的子问题上。 出现平局时，优先分配给评审器自身标记为薄弱的子问题，其次分配给覆盖度最低的那一个。

sents.en: The decision follows a fixed order:
sents.zh: 该决策遵循固定的顺序：

paragraphs.en: no critique was produced ⇒ \Rightarrow report (defensive stop);
paragraphs.zh: 未产生任何评审 ⇒ \Rightarrow 报告（防御性停止）；

paragraphs.en: the critic judges the evidence sufficient ⇒ \Rightarrow report;
paragraphs.zh: 评论者判断证据充分 ⇒ \Rightarrow 报告；

paragraphs.en: the iteration, reading or search-operation budget is used up ⇒ \Rightarrow report;
paragraphs.zh: 迭代、阅读或搜索操作的预算已用完 ⇒ \Rightarrow 报告；

paragraphs.en: The report is written section by section, following the outline produced by global synthesis. Each section receives only the evidence that belongs to it. This keeps citations accurate and stops a long report from degrading toward the end. Documents are cited inline by registry identifier ( [doc_0012] ). After generation, any identifier not in the registry is removed from its bracketed group, and the reference list is built from the documents actually cited in the body. A citation can therefore point only to a document that was retrieved. Some sections are produced deterministically from the state rather than by the model: the scope and method section, the reading guide, the source-diversity caveats, contradictions, limitations, and the reason the run stopped. If no evidence was collected, a diagnostic report explains why instead of an empty synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 报告按照全局综合产生的提纲逐节撰写。 每一节只接收属于它的证据。 这样可以保持引用准确，并防止长篇报告在后半部分质量下降。 文档通过注册表标识符进行内联引用（[doc_0012]）。 生成之后，任何不在注册表中的标识符都会从其括号组中移除，参考文献列表则根据正文中实际引用的文档构建。 因此，引用只能指向被检索到的文档。 某些章节是从状态中确定性地生成，而非由模型生成：范围与方法章节、阅读指南、来源多样性提示、矛盾之处、局限性以及运行停止的原因。 如果没有收集到任何证据，将生成一份诊断报告说明原因，而不是输出空的综述。

sents.zh: 配置分为四层，优先级从低到高依次为：代码默认值、仓库中提交的 optimistresearch.yaml（沿目录路径逐键合并）、用于存放密钥的 .env，以及环境变量，CLI 的命令行标志也会设置这些环境变量。

paragraphs.en: A fully local configuration needs no API keys. We found three factors that decide whether a local model works here, and parameter count matters least. (i) Structured output is constrained to the JSON schema during decoding, so output always parses and the question is whether its content is good. (ii) Ollama’s default context window is 4,096 tokens, and it truncates silently. A screening prompt containing ten abstracts exceeds that, so the context size is set on every call. (iii) Mixing models across roles makes Ollama unload and reload weights between calls, which dominates runtime, so every role should use one model. Among the models we tested, gemma4 produced critiques grounded in the actual state. gpt-oss passed a screening test but judged an obviously relevant paper irrelevant during extraction and returned no evidence, a failure that a general benchmark would not have revealed.
paragraphs.zh: 全本地配置无需 API 密钥。 我们发现了三个决定本地模型在此是否可用的因素，其中参数量的影响最小。 (i) 结构化输出在解码时被约束于 JSON 模式，因此输出总能被解析，问题只在于其内容是否足够好。 (ii) Ollama 的默认上下文窗口为 4,096 个 token，且会静默截断。 一条包含十篇摘要的筛选提示词就会超出该上限，因此每次调用时都需设置上下文大小。 (iii) 在不同角色间混用模型会使 Ollama 在调用之间卸载并重新加载权重，这主导了运行时间，因此每个角色应使用同一个模型。 在我们测试的模型中，gemma4 生成的评审意见能够立足于实际状态。gpt-oss 通过了筛选测试，但在抽取阶段将一篇明显相关的论文判定为不相关且未返回任何证据，这一失败是一般性基准测试所无法揭示的。

paragraphs.en: 284 offline tests cover the deterministic machinery: the deduplication hierarchy, reducers under fan-in, ranking and allocation, snowball saturation, source parsing against recorded API responses, and corpus round-tripping. They also run the whole graph end to end against a fake model and fake sources. The tests do not measure the quality of model output. For that, a separate script runs a candidate model against the real schemas and prompts and flags the failure modes that matter: keeping a deliberately off-topic paper, rejecting a relevant one, and copying search intents from the prompt’s own examples. Another script checks the source adapters against the live APIs. Scholarly APIs reject the entire request when one field is wrong, so a misspelled field name disables a whole source while every offline test still passes. Three real adapter bugs were found this way.
paragraphs.zh: 284 个离线测试覆盖了确定性机制：去重层级、扇入下的归约器、排序与分配、雪球饱和、针对已记录 API 响应的来源解析，以及语料库的往返处理。 这些测试还使用假模型和假来源对整个图进行端到端运行。 这些测试并不衡量模型输出的质量。 为此，一个单独的脚本让候选模型在真实模式与提示词上运行，并标记出重要的失败模式：保留一篇刻意设置的离题论文、拒绝一篇相关论文，以及照抄提示词自带的示例中的搜索意图。 另一个脚本对照线上 API 检查来源适配器。 学术类 API 在任何一个字段出错时都会拒绝整个请求，因此一个拼写错误的字段名会让整个来源失效，而所有离线测试仍然通过。 用这种方法发现了三个真实的适配器缺陷。

paragraphs.en: This paper describes a system and does not evaluate it in a controlled way. We have not yet measured recall against human-curated reviews, the precision of extracted claims, or the contribution of each component, such as decomposition versus a single query or snowballing versus none. The state records what such ablations need, including per-intent yield, the provenance of every document, and the snowball depth at which each was found. Running them is the most important next step.
paragraphs.zh: 本文描述了一个系统，但未以受控方式对其进行评估。 我们尚未测量相对于人工整理的综述的召回率、所提取论断的精确率，以及各组成部分的贡献，例如分解与单一查询的对比，或滚雪球与不使用滚雪球的对比。 状态记录了此类消融实验所需的信息，包括每个意图的产出、每篇文档的来源，以及每篇文档被发现的滚雪球深度。 运行这些实验是最重要的下一步工作。

paragraphs.en: The default reading mode extracts evidence from abstracts. It is fast and cheap, but it limits how strong any claim can be, and the evidence store reflects this honestly. Full-text reading is supported but has not yet been evaluated at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 默认阅读模式从摘要中提取证据。 它快速且成本低廉，但这限制了任何结论所能达到的强度，证据存储也如实反映了这一点。 全文阅读虽受支持，但尚未经过大规模评估。

paragraphs.en: Exact-text claim clustering underestimates how many documents support a claim, because paraphrased claims form separate clusters. A concept graph or embedding-based clustering layer would fit naturally into the evidence store and would make the weak-support signal more reliable.

paragraphs.en: Deterministic machinery cannot recover from screening or extraction errors. In our model tests, the most damaging errors were those that general benchmarks do not measure: rejecting a clearly relevant paper, and copying examples from the prompt as search intents. Model choice for the screener and reader roles should be validated on the system’s own schemas.
paragraphs.zh: 确定性的机器机制无法从筛选或抽取错误中恢复。 在我们的模型测试中，破坏性最大的错误是那些通用基准无法衡量的错误：拒绝一篇明显相关的论文，以及把提示中的示例复制为搜索意图。 筛选器与阅读器角色所选用的模型，应当基于系统自身的模式进行验证。

paragraphs.en: ODR treats literature research as iterative evidence acquisition over an explicit, mutable state. In this setting the research plan is an output of the investigation as well as an input, the result of reading is structured evidence rather than prose, and everything that does not require judgement is deterministic code. This design makes the system auditable: every citation in the report can be traced to a claim, every claim to a document, and every document to the queries and intents that found it. The same traceability made the weaknesses in our case study visible, including repeated snowball seeds, inflated intent yields and silent sources, the first two of which have since been fixed. We expect this property to be as useful when improving the system as when using it.
paragraphs.zh: ODR 将文献研究视为在一个显式、可变的状态上进行的迭代式证据获取。 在这种设定下，研究计划既是研究过程的输入也是其输出，阅读的结果是结构化的证据而非散文式文字，而所有不需要判断的环节都是确定性代码。 这一设计使系统具有可审计性：报告中的每一条引用都可以追溯到一项论断，每项论断可以追溯到一份文档，而每份文档又可以追溯到找到它的查询和意图。 同样的可追溯性也使我们的案例研究中的缺陷得以显现，包括重复的滚雪球种子、虚高的意图产出以及静默失效的数据源，其中前两个问题此后已被修复。 我们期望这一特性在改进系统时和在系统时同样有用。
